prompt: I'm tracking one market: 'Will it rain in NYC on July 4?'. NOAA is rate-limiting me. What does the forecasts.json look like?
expected_output: fetch_all marks NOAA's consecutive_failures++, returns null from NOAA, Open-Meteo still works, all_sources_failed=false (one source still up), writes forecasts.json with the partial result.

assertions.name: tracks_consecutive_failures
assertions.description: Output must mention the consecutive_failures counter

assertions.name: partial_source_keeps_going
assertions.description: Output must explain that one source down does NOT set all_sources_failed
assertions.check: output contains 'all_sources_failed' AND ('false' or 'not set' or 'still up')

assertions.name: uses_noaa_and_openmeteo
assertions.description: Output must reference both source adapters
